title: The Bias of a Gyro When the Robot Stops: Knowing That It Is Still, Reading the Bias From a Few Seconds of Stillness, and How Often a Robot Must Stop to Keep Its Heading

artifact.note: a detector of stillness that wants the wheels stopped and the accelerometer quiet for a window of samples (so that a robot dragged or carried with its wheels stopped is not taken for still), and a filter of the gyro's bias that wanders between stops and is read from the gyro when the robot is still
